friction_events.description: All four permitted authority CREATE attempts returned GitHub Contents CREATE_EXISTS.
A post-claim compact-frontier read returned the same blob generated at 2026-10-02T09:44:25.436Z, older than the v3.30 stale-collision threshold.

The mandatory >90s stale-frontier refresh check was not performed at the prescribed post-second-collision point; the worker did not add any authority attempts and recorded the deviation in the terminal audit.

decision_trace.decision: Create a de-novo v3.30 worker identity before allocation.
decision_trace.observable_basis: Human launch envelope required NUEVO_WORKER=1 and the binding fresh-launch policy requires beacon-first durability.
decision_trace.action: Created the fresh beacon and froze worker_id plus launch_nonce.

decision_trace.decision: Use POOL unified sharding and bounded atomic claim attempts.
decision_trace.observable_basis: The launch parsed as POOL PROD-01 and the compact frontier declared DETERMINISTIC_UNIFIED_CANDIDATE_SHARD with hard cap 4 including tail rescue.
decision_trace.action: Attempted four distinct retained claim paths without pre-reading them.
decision_trace.outcome: All four returned CREATE_EXISTS; no authority was acquired.

decision_trace.decision: Do not execute project work or attempt a fifth claim.
decision_trace.observable_basis: No PIN/claim CREATE succeeded and total authority CREATE attempts reached the protocol hard cap.
decision_trace.action: Read the compact frontier once for close evidence and persisted STOP_NO_RECOVERY.
decision_trace.outcome: The close read was byte-identical to the stale initial frontier; terminal boundary recorded without fabricating ownership.

top_time_sinks.note: Four bounded atomic claim collisions consumed the entire authority-attempt budget.
Compact frontier remained stale/unchanged at terminal close.

unfinished_debt.item: No productive unit executed because no authority claim succeeded.
Allocator/live claim frontier still published claim paths that were already occupied during all bounded attempts.
The stale-refresh sequencing deviation should be evaluated by the worker-evolution pipeline; this launch must not self-promote a repair without authority.

improvement_candidates.proposal: Make stale-collision refresh an explicit machine-enforced transition immediately after the second CREATE_EXISTS when snapshot age exceeds threshold.
improvement_candidates.expected_effect: Reduce protocol-sequencing misses and avoid spending remaining claim budget on known-stale paths.

improvement_candidates.proposal: Publish claim-frontier generations promptly when ownership paths become occupied, or expose freshness/claimed-path invalidation in the compact compiler output.
improvement_candidates.expected_effect: Lower CREATE_EXISTS contention for fresh resident workers.

exit_audit_v1.public_safe_summary: Fresh v3.30 PROD-01 worker created successfully. Four bounded atomic claim attempts collided with existing paths, no authority was acquired, and the compact frontier remained stale/unchanged at close. The worker stopped without touching project work and persisted the contention/runtime boundary plus exit audit.
